$description: Motion Path tokens - Arc trajectories for natural, physics-based movement. Disney principle: arcs follow gravity and momentum.

motion-path.$description: SVG path definitions for arc motion. Paths assume origin at (0,0), normalized to 100-unit scale.

arc-subtle.$description: Gentle arc for small movements. 10% height deviation. Icons, micro-interactions.

arc-medium.$description: Standard arc for card movements, list reordering. 30% height deviation.

arc-large.$description: Dramatic arc for hero animations, page transitions. 50% height deviation.

arc-throw.$description: Ballistic arc for toss, dismiss gestures. Asymmetric - high apex, lower landing.

arc-drop.$description: Gravity drop arc. Steep descent with slight horizontal drift.

arc-rise.$description: Upward arc against gravity. Decelerating rise for toast notifications.

arc-swing.$description: Pendulum swing arc. Oscillating path for side-to-side motion.

arc-orbit.$description: Circular orbit path. For loading spinners, orbital animations.

gravity-simulation.$description: Physics-based arc parameters for realistic motion

earth-gravity.$description: Earth-like gravity. 100 pixels = 1 meter for realistic feel.

light-gravity.$description: Moon-like gravity for floaty, dreamy motion.

heavy-gravity.$description: Heavy gravity for snappy, grounded motion.

path-easing.$description: Easing along the path (separate from path shape)

constant-velocity.$description: Linear progress along path. Object maintains constant speed.

accelerate-along-path.$description: Speed up along the path. Falling objects.

decelerate-along-path.$description: Slow down along the path. Rising objects fighting gravity.

ease-in-out-path.$description: Smooth acceleration and deceleration along path.

direction-hints.$description: When to use arcs vs linear motion

use-arc.$description: Arc motion for physical objects, organic animations, anything affected by gravity.

use-linear.$description: Linear motion for UI feedback, direct user control, mechanical/robotic motion.
